items.title: Add phase-commands and phase/transition-artifacts dimensions to the lifecycle registry
items.context: lifecycle-registry.ts LIFECYCLE_TRANSITIONS already carries gates / effects / oracleRows / rendererRow per transition. Extend the registry with two missing dimensions: (1) which koala commands are legal in each phase, (2) which artifact files (init-check.json / scope-check.json / delivery-check.json / test-evidence.json / summary.json / declared-artifacts.json etc.) each phase or transition produces/consumes. Add read-only projection helpers mirroring the existing lifecycleForwardTransitionsByPhase pattern. Do NOT change public behavior — these are additive projections.

items.title: Add a registry consistency contract test cross-checking command-policy, DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS and process-fact lifecycle
items.context: command-policy.ts allowedPhases, config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS, and the process-fact lifecycle references are currently independent truth sources. Add a contract test that fails when any of them diverges from the lifecycle registry's command/phase dimension — proving phase graph, phase event, command policy, and renderer/oracle references are all validated against one registry. Reuse the existing contract-test pattern (flow-stability / process-fact-contract style).

items.title: Verify phase-flow and context still derive from the registry with zero public behavior change
items.context: phase-flow.ts and context.ts already derive phase order / transition graph from lifecycle-registry. Confirm the registry extension does not change any derived value, and add regression coverage proving phase ordinals, allowed transitions, and existing gate/renderer references are byte-identical before and after. No TEST semantics change, no legacy main-type change, no story_advance restructure — those are Story 2/3/4.
